items.title: 5.4.4 Influence of hydrogen bonding on the properties of water (pani ki properties par hydrogen bonding ka asar) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.4.4, printed pages 102-103, with Quick Check 5.4 and answers.

blocks.text: i. Structure and low density of ice (barf ki banawat aur kam density)

Pani ke molecule ki shakal tetrahedral hai: oxygen ke do lone pairs tetrahedron ke do corners (konon) par hote hain. Jab pani ka temperature kam ho kar barf banti hai to molecules zyada regular (ba-qaida) arrangement mein aa jate hain aur yeh arrangement poori structure mein phail jati hai. Is hydrogen-bonded network (jaal) mein khali jagahen ban jati hain (Figure 5.6). Isi liye jamne par pani 9% zyada jagah gherta hai aur us ki density kam ho jati hai, aur barf pani par tairti hai. Barf ke is anomalous (anokhe) behaviour ki wajah se machhliyan aur doosre jandar jami hui jheelon aur samandaron ke neeche zinda rehte hain: kam density wali barf ki chadar pani ka surface dhanp leti hai aur neeche wala pani bahar ki thand se insulated (bacha hua) rehta hai.

blocks.alt: Do hisse saath saath. (a) Baen taraf: pani ke do molecules ball and stick ki shakal mein; baen molecule ka O (2δ-) dashed hydrogen bond se daen molecule ke H (δ+) se juda. Measurements: O se O 2.8 A; hydrogen bond par O se H 1.8 A; covalent O-H 1.0 A. (b) Daen taraf: barf ki do stacked hexagonal layers; har red O ke do chhote solid-line covalent bonds white H atoms se, aur dashed hydrogen bonds H ko qareeb wale O se jorte hain; beech mein khuli hexagonal jagahen.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.6: Barf mein extensive hydrogen bonding aur molecules ke darmiyan khali jagahen (kitab ki Figure 5.6 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (a) mein ek H do oxygen atoms ke darmiyan hai: apne O se covalent bond (1.0 Å, chhota aur mazboot) aur doosre O se hydrogen bond (1.8 Å, lamba aur kamzor). (b) mein har O ke saath do H covalent bonds se jure hain aur dashed hydrogen bonds molecules ko ek khule hexagonal (chhe-kona) network mein jorte hain. Beech ki khali jagahon ki wajah se barf pani se 9% zyada jagah leti hai aur us ki density kam hoti hai, is liye barf tairti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 5.6 (a) mein daen wale oxygen par charge ka label do baar chhapa hai (‘2δ’ aur ‘2δ−’). Sahi ek hi label 2δ− hai, jaisa upar diagram mein hai.

blocks.alt: Gehre neele-grey samandar mein safed barf ka ek chaura, chapta tukra tair raha hai. Us ke seedhe kinare halke neele hain, aur pani ki satah par aur us se zara neeche feroza (turquoise) patti nazar aati hai. Baen taraf door ufaq par aur barf hai.
blocks.caption: Glacier (barf ke bohat bare tode) ka yeh hissa barf ki kam density ki wajah se pani ki satah par tair raha hai (kitab ki chhapi tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).
